management_notes: The May 2026 data-compilation correction to Frost Cove results remains the key management credibility overhang. The company disclosed promptly, but corrected intercepts for some holes (FC25-17: 2.00% Sb over 0.10m; FC25-27: 13.00% Sb over 0.57m) showed narrower widths than originally reported — a meaningful QA/QC failure for a single-asset explorer whose investment case rests entirely on drill data. The original headline numbers (7.25% Sb over 1.98m and 6.44% Sb over 2.06m) survive in corrected form. Orderly execution of the Golden Baie option (TSXV-approved March 2026, Canstar share consideration issued) and launch of the 2026 two-rig program demonstrate operational competence. Insider ownership remains opaque from public data. Score cannot recover to 3 until at least one full clean disclosure cycle follows the QA/QC incident — the 2026 program assay release will be the first test of that.
geology_notes: The 2025 maiden drill program at Black Raven established high-grade antimony mineralisation at Frost Cove over approximately 800m strike — corrected standout intercepts include 7.25% Sb over 1.98m and 6.44% Sb over 2.06m near the Southern Shaft. The 2026 two-rig program has completed 9 holes targeting the northern strike extension (~500m untested) and the Pomley Cove Pond gold-silver-molybdenum-lead-zinc vein swarm (20 veins within 150m width confirmed by channel sampling). As of 2026-07-14, assay results from both target areas remain unconfirmed — news sources returned 403 on this run and no public announcement could be retrieved. No NI 43-101-compliant resource estimate exists for either property, which hard-caps the geology score at 3 regardless of intercept quality. Golden Baie (39,925 ha, 29 licences) adds district-scale optionality. Score advances to 4 upon filing of a compliant resource.
capital_notes: 316.7M shares issued and 342.8M fully diluted is a heavy share structure for an early-stage explorer with no NI 43-101 resource. The 15.8M shares issued to Canstar as Golden Baie option consideration (TSXV-approved March 2026) are included in the current outstanding count. Options total 23.45M (~7.4% dilution above issued); warrants are modest at 2.625M with no strike/expiry detail available from the April 2026 interim MD&A extraction. No flow-through tranches were detected in the extracted filing data, though flow-through financing is structurally common for NL-domiciled explorers given the Newfoundland and Labrador Mineral Exploration Tax Credit — any 2026 equity raise funding the two-rig program would likely carry 4-month hold-release overhang risk on FT tranches. Two active exploration programs (Black Raven + Golden Baie) sustain ongoing dilution pressure.
catalyst_notes: Catalyst density remains high as of 2026-07-14. The 9-hole 2026 Frost Cove northern extension program assays were described as expected imminently as of July 13 — as of this run, no confirmed release was retrievable (news sources blocked). The Pomley Cove Pond vein-swarm first-drill results are also in the pending queue. Additional 2026 catalysts include: (1) systematic geophysics and trenching results from Golden Baie; (2) potential critical-mineral grant or federal partnership announcement leveraging Canada/US antimony designation; (3) strategic-partner or offtake inquiry driven by Beaver Brook's proximity and Western supply-chain urgency. Score 4 maintained: the binary assay event is still pending and represents the highest-impact near-term catalyst. Score would revise to 5 on confirmed clean results expanding the corrected 2025 intercepts, or to 2 on a second data-quality failure.
acquisition_notes: No NI 43-101 resource exists on either Black Raven or Golden Baie, making P/NAV analysis impossible and nav_per_share accordingly null. Comparable Western-hemisphere antimony M&A transactions are scarce, limiting precedent benchmarking. The strategic rationale is qualitatively strong — consolidated Newfoundland antimony district, proximity to Beaver Brook (historic infrastructure, China Minmetals, care and maintenance), Western supply urgency — but cannot be quantified without a resource. The May 2026 QA/QC incident temporarily reduces appeal to a technical acquirer in due diligence. Score 2 reflects verifiable high-grade mineralisation and a strategic commodity but no quantifiable value anchor; advances to 3 upon a compliant resource filing.
analyst_summary: Churchill Resources is one of the few TSXV-listed primary antimony explorers in Canada at a moment when the metal is designated critical in both Canada and the US. Its consolidated Newfoundland footprint — Black Raven plus the optioned Golden Baie (39,925 ha) — covers a district with proven historical production at Beaver Brook and high-grade corrected drill intercepts at Frost Cove (7.25% Sb over 1.98m). As of 2026-07-14, assay results from 9 completed 2026 drill holes remain unconfirmed (all news sources returned 403 on this run). The scorecard is unchanged from July 13: the May 2026 QA/QC correction is the primary management overhang, and the 316.7M issued / 342.8M fully diluted share count is heavy for a no-resource explorer. WATCH maintained. A move to BUY requires both a clean NI 43-101 resource filing and a clean disclosure track record following the correction. The 2026 assay release is the binary pivot point. Confidence low pending confirmation of assay newsflow.
